exposure: Implementation of a cesarean-delivery technique checklist
outcome: Cord traction for third stage of labor
cohort: All cesarean deliveries at Gynecology Clinic B of the University of the Republic, Montevideo, Uruguay, between January 1 and December 31, 2011 (296 deliveries)
finding: While overall adherence to prescribed cesarean-delivery techniques remained low, implementation of a technique checklist improved the odds of several techniques being applied.
